Arunachal and Assam face severe floods and landslides

Heavy monsoon rains have caused widespread flooding and landslides in Arunachal Pradesh and Assam. Several villages have been cut off, and bridges have been washed away, disrupting connectivity. The region is battling the severe impact of the ongoing rains.
